# Shibumi 0.1.1-beta.14.1

Beta.14 with the release gate fixed. v0.1.1-beta.14 was tagged but never
published: its validation pipeline failed on an obsolete predecessor fixture,
not on the product. Product behavior is unchanged; only version constants
changed in the product payload.

## Included (from Beta.14)

- Guarded hosted-widget popout release during live removal (#51)
- Beta.12/13 predecessor identities in the lifecycle contract (#53)
- Network telemetry binding loops eliminated
- Top-level widgets restored after output loss without recovery rescan
  (#54, confirmation pending)

## Validation

Local runtime gate: package update Beta.13 → 14.1 and fresh install on an
empty host, both green on Omarchy 4.0.3. Host-compatibility gates and physical
DP-1 evidence are inherited from the Beta.14 candidate (see CHANGELOG).
No new hardware run.

## Known limits

See CHANGELOG.md, section 0.1.1-beta.14.1.

## Install

Install from tag `v0.1.1-beta.14.1`, not from `main`. Source checkouts outside
the admitted revisions must run `uninstall --keep-settings` from their exact
checkout first.
